lines.say: Master cutter Henry GROSS-bard created the radiant cut in the late nineteen seventies.

lines.text: Emerald cuts had gone out of style, so he added sparkle.
Its outline has eight sides, with the four corners cut off.
Those trimmed corners help protect it from chipping.
Unlike a princess cut, its trimmed corners make it more durable.
An emerald cut has long step facets, a radiant has brilliant ones.
Mixed facets give some areas a flash and others a soft twinkle.
After its patent expired, other cutters copied the style.
The original is branded The Original Radiant Cut.

post.caption: A radiant diamond looks like crushed ice. Master cutter Henry Grossbard created the radiant cut in the late 1970s. Emerald cuts had gone out of style, so he added sparkle. Its outline has eight sides, with the four corners cut off. Those trimmed corners help protect it from chipping. Unlike a princess cut, its trimmed corners make it more durable. An emerald cut has long step facets, a radiant has brilliant ones. Mixed facets give some areas a flash and others a soft twinkle. After its patent expired, other cutters copied the style. The original is branded The Original Radiant Cut.
